title: How the UCAS October Deadline Works for Oxbridge
summary: Learn how the UCAS October deadline works for Oxbridge and medicine, including school cutoffs, admissions tests, extra forms, and key dates.
body_markdown:
Understanding how the **UCAS October deadline works for Oxbridge** and medicine matters because it is not simply the date when a student presses submit. For **2027 entry** , UCAS must receive eligible applications by **18:00 UK time on 15 October 2026** to guarantee equal consideration.


The deadline covers all Oxford and Cambridge undergraduate courses and most medicine, dentistry, veterinary medicine, and veterinary science courses. Admissions tests, school approval, references, Cambridge's additional form, and Oxford written work may have separate dates, so IB students need a complete application calendar.


### What the 15 October UCAS deadline means


The October date is an **equal consideration deadline** . An application received by UCAS before that point must be considered through the same admissions process as other on-time applications.


UCAS may transmit a late application, but equal consideration is no longer guaranteed. Oxford, Cambridge, and medical schools follow strict selection timetables, so submitting late is not a safe strategy.


A complete application normally includes:


- Personal details and education history
- Course choices entered at that stage
- Pending IB qualifications and achieved results
- Answers to the three UCAS personal statement questions
- An academic reference and predicted grades
- Payment and final submission to UCAS


Sending the form to your school is **not** the same as submitting it to UCAS. The school must check the application, attach the reference and predicted grades, and forward everything before **18:00 UK time** . The[official UCAS deadline guidance](https://www.ucas.com/applying/applying-to-university/dates-and-deadlines-for-uni-applications) therefore advises students to follow their school's earlier internal deadline.


### Key dates for 2027 entry


Date or period Required action


Early September 2026 Completed UCAS applications can begin to be submitted.


School's internal deadline Send the form to the school for checking, predictions, and the reference.


16 September 2026, 15:00 UK time UCAT registration and booking close.


24 September 2026 Final UCAT test day.


15 October 2026, 18:00 UK time Oxbridge and most medicine-related UCAS applications are due.


22 October 2026, 18:00 UK time My Cambridge Application is due for most applicants.


10 November 2026 Oxford written work is due where required.


November-December Shortlisting, invitations, and many interviews take place.


These dates overlap with predicted-grade decisions, Internal Assessments, the Extended Essay, TOK work, and DP2 teaching. An[IB university application checklist](https://www.revisiondojo.com/blog/how-to-apply-to-university-as-an-ib-student-step-by-step-guide-for-global-admissions) can help separate administrative tasks from academic preparation.


### Your school's deadline comes first


Schools commonly set internal deadlines in September or early October. Although this is not the official UCAS deadline, missing it can prevent an on-time submission because the school controls the reference, predicted grades, and final forwarding process.


Ask your counsellor or IB coordinator:


1. When must the completed form reach the school?
2. When are predicted grades finalised?
3. Who checks and submits the application?


Predicted grades for pending qualifications are normally supplied through the school. RevisionDojo's guide to[IB predicted-grade submission dates](https://www.revisiondojo.com/blog/when-are-ib-predicted-grades-submitted-to-universities-what-every-student-needs-to-know) explains why these university predictions are separate from later IB administrative submissions.


### Oxford requirements beyond UCAS


Oxford applications must reach UCAS by **15 October 2026 at 18:00 UK time** , but individual courses may also require an admissions test, written work, or both. For 2027 entry, required written work must reach the relevant college by **10 November 2026** . Oxford's[official admissions timeline](https://www.ox.ac.uk/admissions/undergraduate/applying/admissions-timeline) warns that test registration or booking may close before UCAS applications are due.


Oxford Medicine applicants take the **UCAT** . Oxford currently publishes an IB requirement of **39 points including core points, with 766 at Higher Level** , including Chemistry and at least one of Biology, Physics, or Mathematics at HL. Meeting the minimum does not guarantee shortlisting, so applicants should verify current rules on the official[Oxford Medicine course page](https://www.ox.ac.uk/admissions/undergraduate/courses/course-listing/medicine) and distinguish minimum eligibility from competitiveness using the[Oxford IB score guide](https://www.revisiondojo.com/blog/ib-score-for-oxford-course-requirements) .


### Cambridge requirements beyond UCAS


Most Cambridge applicants submit UCAS by **15 October 2026 at 18:00 UK time** and complete **My Cambridge Application** by **22 October 2026 at 18:00 UK time** . Cambridge normally emails instructions after receiving the UCAS application, so applicants should monitor their inbox and spam folder.


The additional form may request a transcript, topics studied, funding details, test information, and an optional Cambridge-specific statement. Cambridge's[additional application guidance](https://www.undergraduate.study.cam.ac.uk/apply/how/cambridge-application) notes that obtaining a transcript can take several weeks.


Cambridge Medicine publishes a minimum offer level of **41-42 points with 776 at HL** for 2027 entry. Chemistry HL is required, while additional science or mathematics requirements vary by college. Check the official[Cambridge application dates](https://www.undergraduate.study.cam.ac.uk/apply/application-dates-deadlines) , the chosen college, and the[Cambridge IB score guide](https://www.revisiondojo.com/blog/ib-score-for-cambridge) .


### Medicine choices and UCAT timing


UCAS allows five choices overall, but no more than **four choices** may be in medicine, dentistry, veterinary medicine, or veterinary science. A medicine applicant can use the fifth choice for another subject, leave it unused, or add an eligible later-deadline choice after submitting.


The fifth choice does not necessarily need to be entered by 15 October if it has the later January deadline. However, it receives the same personal statement responses, so applicants should check whether the course accepts medicine-focused material.


For the 2026 UCAT cycle, booking closes on **16 September** and testing ends on **24 September** . Medical schools use results differently, including thresholds, rankings, or combined academic and contextual scoring. Verify the[official UCAT dates](https://www.ucat.ac.uk/about-ucat/ucat-test-dates/) and compare course policies through the[Medical Schools Council application guide](https://www.medschools.ac.uk/for-students/applying-to-medical-school/making-an-application/) .


### Can you apply to Oxford and Cambridge?


Most undergraduate applicants may choose **one course at either Oxford or Cambridge** , not one at each. Narrow exceptions involving certain graduate medicine applications do not apply to the typical school-leaver IB applicant.


Choose by comparing course content, teaching structure, college requirements, admissions assessments, and likely IB offers. Reputation alone is not a useful basis for deciding between substantially different courses.


### A practical application plan


### September


- Finalise choices against predicted grades and HL requirements.
- Complete the three personal statement responses within the overall **4,000-character** limit.
- Take the UCAT and register for any other required assessments.
- Allow sufficient time for the school reference and checks.


### Early October and beyond


- Submit before the school's internal cutoff.
- Check IB subjects, levels, qualifications, and course codes.
- Identify separate forms, tests, written work, and portfolios.
- After 15 October, complete Cambridge forms or Oxford written work promptly.
- Begin interview preparation while maintaining IB coursework performance.


Useful preparation involves explaining unfamiliar material aloud, defending assumptions, and responding constructively to prompts. RevisionDojo's guide to[how universities assess UCAS applications](https://www.revisiondojo.com/blog/how-universities-assess-ucas-applications) clarifies the roles of grades, tests, references, written work, and interviews.


### Common deadline mistakes


- Treating 15 October as midnight instead of **18:00 UK time**
- Sending the form to school on the final day
- Attempting to register for UCAT in October
- Assuming UCAS covers every supplementary requirement
- Ignoring course-specific IB subjects or HL conditions
- Allowing academic performance to decline after submission


### Conclusion


For 2027 entry, UCAS must receive eligible Oxbridge and most medicine applications by **15 October 2026 at 18:00 UK time** . Successful planning begins with the school's earlier cutoff and continues through admissions tests, additional forms, written work, and interviews.


Treat the application as connected tasks while protecting DP2 performance. RevisionDojo's Questionbank, Study Notes, Mock Exams, Flashcards, and Jojo AI can support revision when application work overlaps with assessments and IB coursework.
